cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a quiet seaside tide pool bordered by smooth volcanic rock — catching a small white sunhat that has floated within reach after a light breeze; a sheltered picnic pavilion beside an ancient hillside plum orchard in clear spring daylight — laughing quietly after folding her plain white lunch napkin into a small bird; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — holds her keepsake at chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — holds a cup in both hands; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — standing; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — seated on a chair
